verdicts.reason: A keeps the purple circle as a solid backing for 'Smart Home / GADGETS', so the text reads correctly and the brand stays intact. Its flaws: the robot is cropped down to an anonymous arc, the thin frame outline cuts through the photo, the dot grid is crammed under the headline inside the circle, and the text block sits off-centre with a cramped right margin. B puts white text straight onto the busy robot and wood-grain photo, which breaks the no-text-on-busy-image rule. It also reverses the reading order, with GADGETS above 'Smart Home', and shrinks the brand's purple circle to a meaningless sliver in the bottom corner, beside a stray dot cluster.
